tools.name: populate_template
tools.description: Fill a previously uploaded locked PowerPoint template from a connected source or a CSV / spreadsheet export. Masters stay. Charts stay charts. CSV fills are grounding-checked: every figure comes from the data.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "populate_template" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Fill a previously uploaded locked PowerPoint template from a connected source. Masters stay.
